en.html:
The enemy tsurugi was waving its toy weapon.

What was that supposed to be?

Pagal hai kya?

Functional beauty at one end of the world, this thing at the farthest opposite end—and holding it up, you call yourself a warrior?

Fool. Fool. FOOL. FOOL.

Ugly.
Filthy.

Those arms holding the ridiculous weapon were equally useless.
Not a trace of martial skill.

Lift it with strength. Drop it with strength. Bas, entire education completed.

Children playing swords.

Call it woodcutting and the woodcutters would be insulted.

A monkey has learned to hold a stick. That is your level.

Incompetent wretch.

You have no business dancing in the sky.
Go under the earth. Let the worms eat you.

Why are you not doing it?

I will make it happen.

I will turn you into food for the worms.

ja.html:
敵騎が<ruby>玩具<rt>おもちゃ</rt></ruby>のような武器を振りかざしている。

　何だそれは。

　馬鹿か。

　そんな機能美の対極の最果てにある代物を掲げて、
<ruby>一端<rt>いっぱし</rt></ruby>の武者を気取るのか。

　<ruby>愚<rt>おろ</rt></ruby>か愚か愚か愚か。

　醜い。
　<ruby>穢<rt>きたな</rt></ruby>い。

　馬鹿げた武器を構える双腕も同様に愚劣。
　およそ一切の武の<ruby>術技<rt>わざ</rt></ruby>らしきものが無い。

　あれは力で振り上げて力で打ち下ろすだけの<ruby>構<rt>かまえ</rt></ruby>だ。

　子供のちゃんばら遊びだ。

　<ruby>木樵<rt>きこり</rt></ruby>と云えば木樵に失礼だ。

　棒の扱いを覚えた猿、そんなところだ。

　無能。

　貴様は空に踊る資格など持たない。

　地の底に沈んで虫に食われていればいい。

　何故そうしない。

　そうさせてやる。

　俺が貴様を地虫の餌にする。

en.html:
See now.
You fool.

Taking a weapon from an amateur’s hands—simple work.

There are different ways to meet an attack.
Let the force pass. Absorb it. Keep it from developing in the first place.

Or send it back.
Swordsmanship also has that kind of reception: a shock returned to the attacker’s hands, more than they can hold.

You did not know even that?
Even this first lesson?

Battlefield and playground, same place for you, you ignorant bastard.

Here, of all places, you came to play.

And while playing—

————YOU KILLED THEM!!

I squeezed the heat inside me into a narrower flow.
Concentrate. Condense. Accelerate. Increase.

Heat produced electricity. Electricity carried magnetism.

Uemon-no-jou Muramasa. The Ending stroke.
For this blade of lightning, diamond and wastepaper were worth the same.

That showpiece of a wooden dummy, its weapon already gone—could it stop this once in ten thousand tries?

Not once.

Forced the rising fury down into my stomach.

No wasting strength.
Afterward, that strength would be needed.

How much work to rescue her, I did not know...

Or to find out that she was dead—
